beats.say: The Hunger Games prequel cast is complete for its 2026 release.
Lionsgate confirms the team for Sunrise on the Reaping, arriving 20 November 2026.
Director Francis Lawrence returns to Panem with a screenplay by Billy Ray.
Based on Suzanne Collins' novel, the story travels back 24 years before Katniss.
Producers Nina Jacobson and Brad Simpson bring the Second Quarter Quell to life.
With the cast and date set, your return to the arena is less than a month away.
Are you ready to see the 50th Hunger Games?

facts: The Hunger Games Sunrise on the Reaping is scheduled to be released on November 20, 2026.
The film is directed by Francis Lawrence.
The screenplay is by Billy Ray.
The film is based on the novel by Suzanne Collins.
The film is set 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games.
The 50th Hunger Games is known as the Second Quarter Quell.
The film is produced by Nina Jacobson, Brad Simpson, and Francis Lawrence.
